desc:
💥 Admin Ragdoll Lab is a ragdoll physics sandbox where you control the whole city. Spawn a crowd, switch off gravity, and hit Fling All to send every dummy tumbling into the sky!

✋ Grab, swing, and throw ragdolls into walls or through the air.
🧍 Spawn Classic Man, Buff Noob, or Verity. Use the Clone Tool to turn one dummy into a crowd.
⏸️ Freeze time, move ragdolls around in midair, then hit play and watch them fall in slow motion.
🌊 Send a tsunami down the street or turn on Banana Rain for 15 seconds of slipping and sliding.
🔫 Try the Balloon Gun, Harpoon Gun, Rocket Launcher, Black Hole Gun, and Nuke Gun.
⚡ Fly through walls, super jump over rooftops, or grow to eight times your size.
🌙 Switch between moon, zero, and heavy gravity to see how far the same throw can go.
🏗️ Rebuild the city and revive every dummy with your admin menu.
